scripts.push-migrations: dotenvx run --quiet -f ../../.env -- supabase db push && pnpm generate-types
scripts.reset-remote-database: dotenvx run --quiet -f ../../.env -- supabase db reset --linked && pnpm generate-types && pnpm seed-buckets
scripts.generate-types: dotenvx run --quiet -f ../../.env -- sh -c 'supabase gen types --linked > src/database.types.ts' && pnpm build
scripts.start-local-stack: dotenvx run --quiet -f ../../.env -- sh -c 'supabase start && supabase status -o env > ../../.env.generated' && pnpm seed-buckets:local
scripts.reset-local-database: dotenvx run --quiet -f ../../.env.generated -f ../../.env -- sh -c 'supabase db reset && supabase gen types --local > src/database.types.ts' && pnpm build && pnpm seed-buckets:local
scripts.generate-types:local: dotenvx run --quiet -f ../../.env.generated -f ../../.env -- sh -c 'supabase gen types --local > src/database.types.ts' && pnpm build
